data.reason: The triage could see no evidence for: Biome, ast-grep and dependency-cruiser run on staged files in the pre-commit hook in under ten seconds, and in CI on the tree, with the ground rules above each proven by a fixture that fails (among them: node:fs imported inside packages/core, a marketplace write outside the policy gate, a query outside the repository layer); knip reports zero unused exports on packages/core and the connectors, every package declares an exports map, and each rule in the set cites a finding id or an architecture section, enforced in CI. A criterion with nothing behind it is answered at the tdd stage, by writing the test or the check that proves it, rather than by a reviewer reading a diff that does not contain it
